description: This file contains shell script code for configuring and managing WireGuard VPN interfaces, including functions for setup, peer configuration, key generation, and teardown.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_init_config
methods.description: Initializes WireGuard protocol configuration with parameters like private key, listen port, mtu, and fwmark.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup_peer
methods.description: Configures a WireGuard peer with parameters such as public key, preshared key, allowed IPs, endpoint, and persistent keepalive.

methods.name: ensure_key_is_generated
methods.description: Checks if the private key for a given network interface is set to 'generate' and creates a new key if needed.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup
methods.description: Sets up a WireGuard interface, including creating the interface, applying configuration, assigning IP addresses, and managing dependencies.
